name: NeRF with Unknown Camera Parameters
aliases: Joint Camera Pose and Radiance Field Refinement
Joint Optimization of NeRF and Poses
Joint optimisation of NeRF and camera parameters
definition: A method that jointly optimises camera parameters along with a NeRF model on a sparse set of forward-facing views, eliminating the need for pre-estimated camera poses.
summary: NeRF with Unknown Camera Parameters jointly optimizes neural radiance fields and camera poses, eliminating the need for pre-estimated camera parameters.
